notes.title: Archons: Arena has left Early Access
notes.content:
Good Citizens,

After a year of development, Archons: Arena has left Early Access.

The full release includes:

 30 unique opponents
 77 items
 111 skills
 7 weapon types: Sword, Shield, Blunt, Dagger, Spear, Ranged, Throwing
 6 magic schools: Conjuration, Elementalism, Ether, Mentalism, Blood Magic, Life Force
 6 attributes: Constitution, Agility, Intelligence, Preparation, Charisma, Specialization
 2 fully-voiced shopkeepers

The release also includes an in-game editor, allowing you to customize and extend the game to your liking. The modifications are saved in the %APPDATA% folder. There are 4 main categories that can be edited.

Items
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528581/49a210c0e7ccfd6fdc2e57767cb25904862d411a.jpg

 Value determines the cost of the item in shop
 Uses determines how many rounds the item can be used before it's worn out
 Probability determines the likelihood of the item appearing in the shop

Cards
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528581/9acecdf74bbbcc16c42d6611e80407e4eab6ae8f.jpg

 Cost determines the energy cost to play the card
 Probability determines the chance that the card will be played successfully
 Single Use determines if the card can only be played once per round
 In order for a card to be available to the player, a Skill needs to be created that will grant the card to the player

Skills
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528581/1a6c9374ab11f74cbf165118a151aaf58196639c.jpg

 Category determines under which weapon/magic/attribute category the skill will appear
 Cost determines the number of skills points required to unlock the skill
 Requires determines which other Skills must be unlocked before the current skill can be unlocked
 Cards determines the cards and number of copies granted to the player when the skill is unlocked
 Instant Effects and Permanent Effects provide bonuses to the player on unlock

Opponents
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528581/683999ec534eedfdd30ba3704419ba2b4aaa108d.jpg

 Level determines when the opponent will start appearing in the arena, with higher level opponents only appearing in the later rounds
 HP determines the number of hit points
 Block determines the default block value at the start of each turn
 Cards determines the cards and number of copies in the opponent's deck
 Effects provide buffs/debuffs for the opponent
 When creating a new opponent, a single .png file may be provided for the Idle Images field. If multiple images are provided, then they will be rendered in a loop at 30fps.

notes.title: Conjuration Update
notes.content:
Good Citizens,

We are pleased to announce new additions to the arena. This is the last content update during Early Access before the full release in September.

Enhancements
A Conjurer is able to adapt to any situation, summoning the right weapons and bonuses at the right time.

 Conjure a Weapon - conjure a weapon of choice
 Conjure a Bonus -  conjure a bonus of choice
 Polymorph - transform the target into something else
 Superior Weapons - receive a superior selection of weapons during conjuration
 Superior Bonuses - receive a superior selection of bonuses during conjuration

Items

 Conjurer Robes - armor item that reduces the energy cost of Conjuration cards.
 Staff of Conjuring - weapon item that adds a free Conjure a Bonus spell to the deck

Opponents

 Battlemage - performs strong magical attacks, occasionally conjures a permanent buff
 Sentinel - retains block between turn, deals damage equal to the block

notes.title: Shopkeeper Update #2
notes.content:
Good Citizens,

Welcome to Dragon's Hoard, a new welcoming establishment to give you respite between your battles. Haruna, the owner of this little shop, is a dedicated and resourceful alchemist who has carved her path through hard work and determination. Running the store can be overwhelming at times but Haruna always keeps a positive attitude and tries to pass it on to her customers. She loves spending time by herself in nature, on hikes and in her flower garden. And she has a cat named Kaito, who can be a handful.

Visit Dragon's Hoard today and say hello to Haruna! You don't want to make her sad, do you?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528581/40706af1dab08a6e2f5a21e848e7e89b1cd40338.jpg

notes.title: Shopkeeper Update
notes.content:
Good Citizens,

Welcome to Veteran's Valor, your supply store for the Arena. Oldben is the proprietor of this establishment. As a military veteran, Oldben has seen his fair share of battles and understands the challenges and risks that come with combat. This has fueled his desire to offer guidance and support to the arena combatants who frequent his shop. He considers his shop to not be just a place of commerce, but also a haven for camaraderie and encouragement. His loyal dog, Valor, provides comfort and companionship to both Oldben and his customers. 

Now as you purchase items, learn skills, and progress through the Arena, Oldben will share his wisdom and experience to encourage you on your journey. A fully-voiced character with 800+ lines.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528581/b9c952ff7578877584ad59202af6c7d5630e2048.jpg

notes.title: January Update
notes.content:
Good Citizens,

We are pleased to announce new additions to the arena for the month of January.

Enhancements
A Life Force mage is a mystical practitioner attuned to the ebb and flow of vitality in the world. With a deep connection to the natural world, they possess the ability to mend wounds, dispel enchantments, and even draw sustenance from the life force of others. Their presence is a harmonious blend of healing warmth and enigmatic power, embodying the delicate balance between nurturing life and wielding the forces of arcane vitality.

 Heal - +1 HP
 Dispel -  clear random effect from target
 Absorb - deal 1 unblockable, leeching damage to target
 Health Bind - absorb 1 HP from target for X turns
 Rejuvenation - restore all hp and heal all injuries, +3 block

Items

 Vitamancer Robes - armor item that reduces the energy cost of Life Force cards.
 Staff of Healing - weapon item that adds a free Heal spell to the deck

Opponents

 Soulthirst - performs strong magical attacks that absorb health from the player
 Vitamancer - performs moderate magical attacks that absorb health from the player, may heal self and other opponents

notes.title: December Update
notes.content:
Good Citizens,

We are pleased to announce new additions to the arena for the month of December.

Enhancements
Blood Mages harness the power of their own life force to unleash devastating abilities upon their foes. It only takes a mere flick of the wrist to summon a burst of shadowy energy that damages all opponents within range, while the mage's connection to the arcane allows them to bend fate itself, granting them access to powerful abilities.

 Splatter - deal 1 damage to all opponents, -1HP
 Divination -  draw 3 cards, -1HP
 Drain Vitality - deal 1 wounding damage to target, -1HP
 Haze - stun target, -2HP
 Burst - deal 1 unblockable damage to all opponents, -2 HP

Opponents

 Crossbowman - performs ranged attacks that have a chance to miss but will inflict an injury when hitting the mark
 Cultist - takes damage every turn but deals double damage every 2 turns

notes.title: November Update
notes.content:
Good Citizens,

We are pleased to announce new additions to the arena for the month of November.

Enhancements
Those attuned to the Ether can harness its energy to gain a strategic advantage without directly damaging the opponent. Skilled etherists assert their dominance by weaving spells that grant substantial protection from attacks, swiftly teleporting to unleash devastating strikes, stripping away the defenses of their foes, conjuring reflective wards, and even assuming an ethereal form to evade incoming assaults.

 Barrier - gain 4 block
 Flanking Teleport - +1 damage this turn
 Remove Block - remove all block from target
 Ethereal Form - 50% chance to dodge attacks
 Reflect Ward - 50% chance to reflect damage

Items

 Etherist Robe - armor item that reduces the energy cost of Ether cards.
 Reflect Crystal - crystal item that provides 15% chance to reflect attacks.
 Staff of Disorientation - weapon item that adds a free Disorient spell to the deck
 Staff of Reflection - weapon item that adds a free Reflect Ward spell to the deck

Opponents

 Spellsword - deals and blocks a moderate amount of damage, may reflect damage
 Etherist - deals and blocks a moderate amount of damage, may reflect damage, may disintegrate items
 Scorpion - poisonous, may perform unblockable attacks

Presentation

 4 new backgrounds
 15 new sound effects
 4 new visual effects

notes.title: October Update
notes.content:
Good Citizens,

We are pleased to announce new additions to the Arena for this month.

Enhancements
Skills
We have added the first school of magic, Mentalism. These abilities are focused on playing games with your opponent's mind rather than dealing direct damage. Magic abilities cannot be used if two weapons are equipped unless you have unlocked Deft Magic, a new skill under the Agility attribute.

 Intuition - Choose 1 card to draw
 Confuse - Add 1 Confusion card to target's deck
 Disorient - 30% chance target will damage self when attacking
 Alter Intent - Change target's intent
 Psy Op - Deal damage equal to number of cards in hand

Charisma is a new attribute that likewise will allow fighters to play mind games with an opponent.

 Demoralize - Reduce number of attacks by 1
 Shout - Remove block from target
 Taunt - +1 damage to target, -30% success chance
 Denigrate - Clear random effect from target
 Crowd Favorite - +1 energy

Items

 Mentalist Robe - armor item that reduces the energy cost of Mentalism cards.
  Lucky Coat  - armor item that adds a random effect at the start of each round
  Cursed Crystal  - crystal item that adds a random negative effect at the start of each round, +25 gold at the end of the round
  Endurance Potion  - potion item that provides immunity to injury for 50 turns
  Discernment Potion  - potion item that provides discernment for 50 turns

Opponents

 Mentalist - will apply negative effects, may steal cards, and perform other unconventional actions
  Ninja  - will apply negative effects, use poisonous attacks
  Novice Mage  - will do moderate attacks but has a chance to damage self

Presentation

 Crowd sound effects have been added
 10 new background music tracks
 vfx for Block card

Balance
Skills

  Rage  - cost increased from 3 to 5. Adds 2 Confusion cards instead of 1.
  Composure  - cost increased from 3 to 5. Adds 2 Confusion cards instead of 1.

Cards

  Crush  - inflicts injury in addition to previous effects

Items

  Swift Dagger  - cost increased from 150 to 200


We are working on adding Ether magic in November's update.

notes.title: Skills Introduction
notes.content:
Good Citizens,

Today we want to take a look at skills fighter are able to learn as they gain more experience. As mentioned in one of the previous articles, each weapon has its own skill tree. Fighters may choose to focus on mastering a single weapon or experiment with several to better adapt to each opponent. In addition to weapon skills, fighter may choose to develop their attributes:

 Constitution - generally will help you survive more hits in a fight
 Agility - for those looking to avoid getting hit
 Intelligence - increases choices and options during a fight
 Preparation - allows you to fine-tune your deck

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528581/5d6b634bd0e91e759581aea93bcc1e8af41f3113.png
Finally, fighters may also choose to learn a Specialization, or even a couple. Specializations provide a permanent boost to the fighter but also come with a drawback. For example, Patient fighters are able to retain unused energy between turns but also have a lower base energy pool.

notes.title: Equipment Introduction
notes.content:
Good Citizens,

Today we want to take a look at the equipment available to the fighters of the arena.

Weapons
Your equipped weapons determine which cards are available to you during the fight. If you are a trained marksman but do not have a bow equipped, those cards will not be in your deck. Up to 2 weapons can be equipped at the same time. Check the previous article for a more detailed overview of various weapon types.

Armor
Armor provides extra block each turn but at the expense of energy loss. Heavier armor provides more block but also has a greater energy penalty. Fighters can negate the energy loss by improving their Armor Mastery skill. Fighters that choose not to wear armor may want to unlock Light-footed specialization that increases your energy pool when not wearing armor.

Crystals
Crystals provide persistent buffs as long as they are equipped. Energy Crystal is always a favorite since it provides +1 energy to the user. Up to two crystals can be equipped at the same time.

Potions
Potions provide temporary effects that will last the first few turns of a fight. Potions must be used prior to entering the arena and cannot be used during the fight. Draw Potion will increase the number of cards drawn per turn for 5 turns, giving you more options during the opening moments.

Next time we will take a look at the fundamental aspects of fighting an opponent.

notes.title: Weapon Introduction
notes.content:
Good Citizens,

Today we want to take a look at the weapons available to you in the arena. But first, a quick intro to the characters stats.

 HP - number of hit points. By default, you will start with 5 HP. If the number falls to 0, the game is over.
 Block - when an opponent attacks, the attack will first reduce your block points before damaging HP. Block resets to 0 at the start of each turn.
 Energy - energy determines how many cards can be played per turn. By default, you will start with 2 energy.

Weapons
Sword
The sword is a great choice for those looking to protect themselves and deal some damage. This is perhaps best exemplified by the first card in the skill tree, Slash. It only costs 1 point of energy while providing 1 point of attack and block.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528581/0cfcc8c21ffe54e0b3e7271705ec7383a98352fb.png
Shield
The shield is the obvious choice for increasing your defense. The skill tree also includes cards to stun the opponent or even to use your block as offensive damage.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528581/f5b35aa6012cb2c6a2132a8a8026fadc4fd752a1.png
Dagger
Fighters equipped with the dagger are able to deal a lot of damage with little energy expenditure but have no way to defend themselves.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528581/b062511f938aeab1512ba88c1a1648b76d8d4f2f.png
Ranged
Ranged weapons, like a bow, offer opportunity to deal high amount of damage but at the cost of possibility of missing the attack entirely.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528581/1c22b2809039ecf6cbb0c4ea46b148b02df16a44.png
Spear
Spear users are able to take advantage of the longer reach to dodge incoming attacks or damage the attacker in return.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528581/570db835db7ddfc2334ac46e7b6e97415b2c2346.png
Blunt
Maces and hammers allow dealing damage against even the most armored opponents, ignoring the block and damaging HP directly.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528581/985e0be1a98ecb52052ba815715d5cbecabce2c2.png
Thrown
Thrown weapons offer low cost utility, allowing the fighter to quickly turn the odds in their favor, but can only be used once per round.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528581/f0c466fed227939de8f2692cf5fd2968874cac82.png

In case you were worried, each of the weapons of course includes more than just 1 card that's been shown here. In the next article, we will take a look at other types of gear available to the fighters.

notes.content:
Good Citizens,

Archons: Arena is coming to Steam Early Access on September 13th.

The first release will include:

 14 unique opponents
 60 items
 75 skills
